# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 2: Maritime Warfare, Letters of Marque, Strait Toll CBs & 5 Historical Expeditions (oe_nav2_). Generated by gen_v125_maritime.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Five Verified Historical Expeditions (oe_nav2_exp_*) — 0 edits to oe_expedition_launch.txt.

# ==============================================================================
# EXPEDITION 1: Northeast Arctic & Mangazeya Passage (Age 3+, travel_mode = both)
# ==============================================================================
oe_nav2_exp_arctic_northeast = {
	unique = yes
	repeatable = no
	dynamic_first_waypoint = yes
	origin = none
	travel_mode = both
	travel_speed = 0.75
	should_end_at_last_waypoint = yes
	fail_if_no_leader = yes
	category = exploration
	show_start_message = no
	show_end_message = no
	ai = no

	variables = {
		num_ships = {
			start = 5
			min = 0
			max = 5
			display = fraction
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/control_groups/navy.dds"
		}
		provisions = {
			start = 100
			min = 0
			max = 100
			display = piechart
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/unit_view/food.dds"
		}
		cargo = {
			start = 0
			min = 0
			max = 50
			display = fraction
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/trade_goods/icon_goods_fur.dds"
		}
	}

	potential = {
		oe_nav2_eligible_arctic_expedition = yes
	}

	can_start = {
		at_war = no
		has_non_rural_port = yes
		gold >= 250
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_arctic_cd }
	}

	leader = {
		is_alive = yes
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = no
		is_expedition_leader = no
		has_exploration = no
	}

	on_start = {
		add_gold = -250
		add_cooldown = {
			type = oe_nav2_exp_arctic_cd
			years = 15
		}
		oe_nav2_pick_ocean_departure_port = yes
		scope:expedition = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = expedition_leader }
				remove_commander = expedition_leader
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_home_loc value = scope:departure_loc }
			add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_loc
			add_new_waypoint = location:bergen
			add_new_waypoint = location:vardo
			add_new_waypoint = location:kola
			add_new_waypoint = location:murman_coast
			add_new_waypoint = location:solovetsky
			add_new_waypoint = location:arkhangelsk
			add_new_waypoint = location:nes
			add_new_waypoint = location:pustozersk
			add_new_waypoint = location:obdorsk
			add_new_waypoint = location:mangazeya
			add_new_waypoint = location:obdorsk
			add_new_waypoint = location:pustozersk
			add_new_waypoint = location:nes
			add_new_waypoint = location:arkhangelsk
			add_new_waypoint = location:kola
			add_new_waypoint = location:vardo
			add_new_waypoint = location:bergen
			add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_loc
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					NOT = { expedition_is_stalled = yes }
				}
			}
			scope:expedition = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						expedition_is_traveling = yes
						NOT = { expedition_is_paused = yes }
					}
					change_variable = { name = provisions subtract = 3 }
					clamp_variable = { name = provisions min = 0 max = 100 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:expedition = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								has_variable = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed
								var:oe_nav2_exp_elapsed >= 120
							}
							var:num_ships <= 0
						}
					}
				}
				fail_expedition = scope:expedition
			}
		}
	}

	on_arrive_to_new_location = {
		scope:location = { discover_location = root }
	}

	on_arrive_to_waypoint = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:location = location:kola
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_kola } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_kola value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.5
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:location = location:arkhangelsk
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_arkhangelsk } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_arkhangelsk value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.6
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:location = location:mangazeya
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_mangazeya } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_mangazeya value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.7
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_done_arctic value = 1 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_nav2_arctic_route_charted
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
		add_prestige = 20
		add_navy_tradition = 10
		capital.market ?= {
			add_goods_supply = {
				goods = goods:fur
				amount = 30
			}
		}
		add_gold = 150
	}

	on_fail = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.17
	}
}

# EXPEDITION 2: Indian Ocean Treasure Fleet Mission (Age 2-5, travel_mode = sea)
# All 17 waypoints verified port=True in vanilla ports.csv (zero guangzhou/palembang).
# ==============================================================================
oe_nav2_exp_indian_ocean_treasure = {
	unique = yes
	repeatable = yes
	dynamic_first_waypoint = yes
	origin = none
	travel_mode = sea
	travel_speed = 0.90
	should_end_at_last_waypoint = yes
	fail_if_no_leader = yes
	category = diplomatic
	show_start_message = no
	show_end_message = no
	ai = no

	variables = {
		provisions = {
			start = 100
			min = 0
			max = 100
			display = piechart
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/trade_goods/icon_goods_porcelain.dds"
		}
		splendor = {
			start = 25
			min = 0
			max = 100
			display = fraction
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/expedition_types/splendor.dds"
		}
		cargo = {
			start = 0
			min = 0
			max = 100
			display = fraction
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/trade_goods/icon_goods_pepper.dds"
		}
	}

	potential = {
		oe_nav2_eligible_indian_ocean_treasure = yes
	}

	can_start = {
		at_war = no
		has_non_rural_port = yes
		OR = {
			country_rank_level >= 3
			is_great_power = yes
		}
		gold >= 350
		NOT = { has_cooldown = treasure_fleet_cooldown }
		NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_treasure_cd }
	}

	leader = {
		is_alive = yes
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = no
		is_expedition_leader = no
		has_exploration = no
	}

	on_start = {
		add_gold = -350
		add_cooldown = {
			type = oe_nav2_exp_treasure_cd
			years = 15
		}
		oe_nav2_pick_ocean_departure_port = yes
		scope:expedition = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = expedition_leader }
				remove_commander = expedition_leader
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_home_loc value = scope:departure_loc }
			add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_loc
		}
		if = {
			limit = { oe_nav2_is_eastern_treasure_origin = yes }
			scope:expedition = {
				add_new_waypoint = location:dinghai
				add_new_waypoint = location:jinjiang
				add_new_waypoint = location:panyu
				add_new_waypoint = location:vijaya
				add_new_waypoint = location:temasek
				add_new_waypoint = location:malacca
				add_new_waypoint = location:pasai
				add_new_waypoint = location:kochi
				add_new_waypoint = location:kozhikode
				add_new_waypoint = location:goa
				add_new_waypoint = location:masqat
				add_new_waypoint = location:hormuz
				add_new_waypoint = location:adan
				add_new_waypoint = location:mogadishu
				add_new_waypoint = location:malindi
				add_new_waypoint = location:mombasa
				add_new_waypoint = location:zanzibar
				add_new_waypoint = location:adan
				add_new_waypoint = location:kozhikode
				add_new_waypoint = location:malacca
				add_new_waypoint = location:jinjiang
				add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_loc
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:expedition = {
				add_new_waypoint = location:adan
				add_new_waypoint = location:masqat
				add_new_waypoint = location:hormuz
				add_new_waypoint = location:goa
				add_new_waypoint = location:kozhikode
				add_new_waypoint = location:malacca
				add_new_waypoint = location:temasek
				add_new_waypoint = location:jinjiang
				add_new_waypoint = location:temasek
				add_new_waypoint = location:malacca
				add_new_waypoint = location:kozhikode
				add_new_waypoint = location:adan
				add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_loc
			}
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					NOT = { expedition_is_stalled = yes }
				}
			}
			scope:expedition = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed add = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:expedition = {
						has_variable = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed
						var:oe_nav2_exp_elapsed >= 120
					}
				}
				fail_expedition = scope:expedition
			}
		}
	}

	on_arrive_to_new_location = {
		scope:location = { discover_location = root }
	}

	on_arrive_to_waypoint = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:location = location:malacca
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_malacca } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_malacca value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.8
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:location = location:kozhikode
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_kozhikode } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_kozhikode value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.9
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:location = location:zanzibar
					AND = {
						NOT = { oe_nav2_is_eastern_treasure_origin = yes }
						scope:location = location:jinjiang
					}
				}
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_terminus } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_terminus value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.10
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_done_treasure value = 1 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_nav2_indian_ocean_prestige
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
		add_prestige = 25
		add_navy_tradition = 12
		add_gold = 220
		capital.market ?= {
			add_goods_supply = {
				goods = goods:pepper
				amount = 25
			}
			add_goods_supply = {
				goods = goods:cloves
				amount = 15
			}
			add_goods_supply = {
				goods = goods:porcelain
				amount = 20
			}
		}
		oe_nav2_grant_location_owner_goodwill = { LOC = location:malacca }
		oe_nav2_grant_location_owner_goodwill = { LOC = location:kozhikode }
	}

	on_fail = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.17
	}
}

# EXPEDITION 3: Trans-Saharan Gold & Sankore Caravan (Age 1-4, travel_mode = land)
# Western route Fez-Sijilmasa-Tindouf-Taghaza-Timbuktu-Djenne-Gao-Kano (zero overlap with oe_cross_the_sahara).
# ==============================================================================
oe_nav2_exp_saharan_scholar_caravan = {
	unique = yes
	repeatable = yes
	dynamic_first_waypoint = yes
	origin = none
	travel_mode = land
	travel_speed = 0.80
	should_end_at_last_waypoint = yes
	fail_if_no_leader = yes
	category = commercial
	show_start_message = no
	show_end_message = no

		knowledge = {
			start = 0
			min = 0
			max = 40
			display = fraction
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/trade_goods/icon_goods_books.dds"
		}
		cargo = {
			start = 0
			min = 0
			max = 60
			display = fraction
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/trade_goods/icon_goods_goods_gold.dds"
		}
	}

	potential = {
		oe_nav2_eligible_saharan_caravan = yes
	}

	can_start = {
		at_war = no
		gold >= 250
		any_owned_location = {
			oe_nav2_is_sahara_caravan_origin = yes
		}
		NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_sahara_cd }
	}

	leader = {
		is_alive = yes
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = no
		is_expedition_leader = no
		has_exploration = no
	}

	on_start = {
		add_gold = -250
		add_cooldown = {
			type = oe_nav2_exp_sahara_cd
			years = 12
		}
		oe_nav2_pick_sahara_departure = yes
		scope:expedition = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = expedition_leader }
				remove_commander = expedition_leader
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_home_loc value = scope:departure_loc }
			add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_loc
			add_new_waypoint = location:sijilmasa
			add_new_waypoint = location:tindouf
			add_new_waypoint = location:taghaza
			add_new_waypoint = location:timbuktu
			add_new_waypoint = location:djenne
			add_new_waypoint = location:gao
			add_new_waypoint = location:kano
			add_new_waypoint = location:timbuktu
			add_new_waypoint = location:taghaza
			add_new_waypoint = location:sijilmasa
			add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_loc
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					NOT = { expedition_is_stalled = yes }
				}
			}
			scope:expedition = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						expedition_is_traveling = yes
						NOT = { expedition_is_paused = yes }
					}
					change_variable = { name = provisions subtract = 4 }
					clamp_variable = { name = provisions min = 0 max = 100 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:expedition = {
						has_variable = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed
						var:oe_nav2_exp_elapsed >= 120
					}
				}
				fail_expedition = scope:expedition
			}
		}
	}

	on_arrive_to_new_location = {
		scope:location = { discover_location = root }
	}

	on_arrive_to_waypoint = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:location = location:taghaza
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_taghaza } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_taghaza value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.11
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:location = location:timbuktu
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_timbuktu } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_timbuktu value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.12
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_done_sahara value = 1 }
		culture = {
			add_cultural_tradition = 8
		}
		add_gold = 200
		capital.market ?= {
			add_goods_supply = {
				goods = goods:goods_gold
				amount = 25
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_nav2_sankore_scholarship
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	on_fail = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.17
	}
}

		scope:location = { discover_location = root }

			limit = {
				scope:location = location:samarkand
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_samarkand } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_samarkand value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.13
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:location = location:shazhou
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_shazhou } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_shazhou value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.14
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_done_silk value = 1 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_nav2_silk_road_compact
			years = 12
			mode = replace
		}
		add_prestige = 20
		capital.market ?= {
			add_goods_supply = {
				goods = goods:silk
				amount = 30
			}
		}
		oe_nav2_grant_location_owner_goodwill = { LOC = location:samarkand }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_nav2_is_eastern_silk_origin = yes }
			oe_nav2_grant_location_owner_goodwill = { LOC = location:constantinople }
		}
		else = {
			oe_nav2_grant_location_owner_goodwill = { LOC = location:dadu }
		}
	}

	on_fail = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.17
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# EXPEDITION 5: Enlightenment Scientific & Classical Survey (Age 5-6, travel_mode = both)
# Dual-branch kickoff via oe_nav2.15 (Branch A: Classical Med-Near East; Branch B: Global Meridian via Guayaquil->Quito).
# ==============================================================================
oe_nav2_exp_enlightenment_survey = {
	unique = yes
	repeatable = yes
	dynamic_first_waypoint = yes
	origin = none
	travel_mode = both
	travel_speed = 0.90
	should_end_at_last_waypoint = yes
	fail_if_no_leader = yes
	category = exploration
	show_start_message = no
	show_end_message = no
	ai = no

	variables = {
		knowledge = {
			start = 0
			min = 0
			max = 100
			display = fraction
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/expedition_types/knowledge.dds"
		}
		experience = {
			start = 100
			min = 0
			max = 100
			display = piechart
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/flat_icons/modernization.dds"
		}
	}

	potential = {
		oe_nav2_eligible_enlightenment_survey = yes
	}

	can_start = {
		at_war = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
		gold >= 300
		NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_enlight_cd }
	}

	leader = {
		is_alive = yes
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = no
		is_expedition_leader = no
		has_exploration = no
	}

	on_start = {
		add_gold = -300
		add_cooldown = {
			type = oe_nav2_exp_enlight_cd
			years = 15
		}
		oe_nav2_pick_ocean_departure_port = yes
		scope:expedition = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = expedition_leader }
				remove_commander = expedition_leader
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_home_loc value = scope:departure_loc }
			add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_loc
			# Seed a valid fallback leg before stalling so the path is never empty on launch tick.
			add_new_waypoint = location:athens
			add_new_waypoint = scope:departure_loc
		}
		stall_expedition = scope:expedition
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.15
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					NOT = { expedition_is_stalled = yes }
				}
			}
			scope:expedition = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed add = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:expedition = {
						has_variable = oe_nav2_exp_elapsed
						var:oe_nav2_exp_elapsed >= 120
					}
				}
				fail_expedition = scope:expedition
			}
		}
	}

	on_arrive_to_new_location = {
		scope:location = { discover_location = root }
	}

	on_arrive_to_waypoint = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:location = location:athens
					scope:location = location:qena
					scope:location = location:hillah
					scope:location = location:quito
				}
				NOT = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = oe_nav2_v_survey_breakthrough } }
			}
			scope:expedition = { set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_v_survey_breakthrough value = 1 } }
			stall_expedition = scope:expedition
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.16
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_done_enlight value = 1 }
		culture = {
			add_cultural_tradition = 12
		}
		add_research_progress = research_progress_extreme_bonus
		add_prestige = 25
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_nav2_royal_academy_laurels
			years = 20
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	on_fail = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.17
	}
}
